status: proposed: F02 submitted, not accepted. This register records no G5 decision. Every retention period for stored personal data is pending_G5; every processor region is unknown until HB-27 is answered. Repair attempt 3 (design review A6D2-02): FL-29 adds the booking-to-contact join (the invitee address as a transient DC-CONTACT matching key, never stored), and DC-BOOKING-INTAKE, FL-06 and FL-15 say so.
decision_owner: The responsible privacy and operations owner at G5 (named through HB-21; decisions asked in HB-27, HB-28). Agents propose; they do not decide retention, processors or consent wording.

data_classes.label: Workshop financial inputs
data_classes.examples: desired spending, income amounts and their start timing, gross/net basis, savings by tax category, home or business value, current and intended retirement ages, household timing, planning horizon, inflation or return assumptions, the local lifestyle choice

data_classes.label: Derived workshop results
data_classes.examples: annual gap or surplus, capital illustration, completeness state, selected branch clip, warning or risk selection, chart series, summary text

data_classes.label: Contact identity
data_classes.examples: normalized email, optional first name, chosen locale, internal contact ID, provider contact ID

data_classes.label: Consent and revocation evidence
data_classes.examples: purpose, granted/requested/revoked, wording version, capture time, capture source, evidence reference

data_classes.label: Operational state
data_classes.examples: registrations, attendance state with evidence source, booking references and times, delivery job state, integration event metadata, audit rows

data_classes.label: Order, payment and entitlement references
data_classes.examples: order ID, Stripe session/payment IDs, product version, payment state, fulfilment state, consultation right state

data_classes.label: Shipping address
data_classes.examples: name and postal address collected by hosted checkout

data_classes.label: Scheduler intake
data_classes.examples: invitee name and email, any intake answer, chosen time and mode, as the scheduler and calendar hold them. The invitee email reaches the application server only as FL-29's transient matching key, under DC-CONTACT, and is never stored; the name and intake answers never do (privacy-boundary.md PB-CAL-3)

data_classes.label: Live meeting presence
data_classes.examples: display name, camera, chat, poll answers, recording

data_classes.label: Existing inquiry form
data_classes.examples: name, email, topic ID, free-text message, language; HMAC of the IP for rate limiting

data_classes.label: Inbound replies
data_classes.examples: email replies to a message or to the contact address

data_classes.label: Technical request data
data_classes.examples: IP address, user agent, request path, timestamps

data_classes.label: Bill's non-identifying notes
data_classes.examples: voice-note transcript or notes for the weekly article, with client identifiers removed

data_classes.label: Editorial content
data_classes.examples: drafts, approved articles, scripts, approval ledger entries

data_classes.label: Aggregate metrics
data_classes.examples: counts of jobs, sends, registrations, held meetings; no personal data

data_classes.label: Secrets and credentials
data_classes.examples: API keys, webhook secrets, encryption keys, OAuth tokens

flows.purpose: none

flows.purpose: none

flows.purpose: Fulfil a request (guide, workshop access, registration, purchase, booking) and hold consent evidence

flows.retention: n8n: execution data minimized, retention pending_G5; Brevo: pending_G5
flows.notes: The job itself never stores the address (delivery-job.schema.json).

flows.purpose: Evidence of explicit consent and revocation per purpose
flows.notes: Append-only. No full IP or device fingerprint (04 §2).

flows.notes: Attributes: language, consent status, guide request, event registration, workshop completion (boolean/date only), book entitlement, booking stage, suppression.

flows.purpose: Join a verified booking to an existing contact (authority-matrix.md AM-BOOK-3): the booking adapter reads the invitee address from the provider record in application-server memory, normalizes it and computes its email_hmac; op_accept_event looks that value up in contacts.email_hmac and stores only the matched contact_id on bookings
flows.basis: the invitee's own booking; purposes: stop appointment-solicitation messages to someone who already booked (04 §6) and send the operational booking messages E15 and E16
flows.retention: the address: none (held in application-server memory for the lookup only, never written); the HMAC: compared, not stored again (contacts.email_hmac already exists); the stored bookings.contact_id follows RC-BOOKING, pending_G5
flows.notes: Only where P05 verifies an authenticated booking read or a signed callback (provider.booking_sync). Otherwise the operator's daily reconciliation applies the same exact-address rule in the operations view (operator.reconciliation, FL-10). No match: the booking is stored without a contact, and no event, job or contact row is created (AM-BOOK-5). The address never reaches bookings, integration_events, an envelope, a job, n8n, a log, an alert or a URL. The invitee's name and intake answers are not read (privacy-boundary.md PB-CAL-3).
